composition.compare: 42 条 = tests/data/real_corpus_pilot_prereg.json 冻结输入集, 原序, 按指针(text_ref), text_2000.v0

composition.rep: 10 条 = 输入集下标 i%4==0 且 i<40 的复跑, 只供确定性前置

gold_source: 42+10 条指针条目无 gold(REVIEW_REQUIRED); smoke 的 gold = 2026-09-24 预设 + 2026-09-27 owner 裁定(登记在 gold_adjudications.json)
